card.title: CONQUEST
card.text: Draw a card for each unit type you control.
card.flavorText: Seeking to secure its position in Europe, Germany began subduing neighboring states in 1938. This started with the annexation of Austria and the subsequent occupation of Czechoslovakia. On 1 September 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland triggered a global conflict, drawing in major Western powers France and Great Britain, who declared war in defense of their ally. Following the fall of Poland and a campaign in Scandinavia, the conflict reached a turning point in May 1940. Germany launched a massive offensive against the West. Despite possessing one of the most formidable militaries in the world, the French and their British allies were outmaneuvered by a high-speed armored breakthrough through the Ardennes. After weeks of intense, large-scale combat that saw the collapse of the Allied front, German forces captured Paris. By late June, France was forced to sign an armistice.
